snippet.title: Tiberium Dusk 1.26 - Core Defender Redeemer (FINAL)
snippet.description:
The new Epic unit coming to Marked of Kane in the upcoming patch, the Core Defender Redeemer. Featuring an extremely powerful laser cannon and mobile stealth generator, as well as self heal abilities, this monster is a force to be reckoned with.
Mod: https://www.moddb.com/mods/tiberium-dusk
Discord server: https://discord.gg/8Cpfepqczy
